Changing the signature of `nameOfDay` (`packages/lib/weekday.ts`) could break 14 files besides `weekday.ts` itself: 5 that call it directly and 9 that call a function that calls it. I grepped for each caller name to confirm the graph results.

**Direct callers (level 1)**
- `packages/lib/weekday.test.ts`: the test file for `nameOfDay`.
- `packages/lib/availability.ts`: `availabilityAsString()` calls it.
- `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/AvailableTimesHeader.tsx`
- `apps/web/modules/settings/my-account/general-view.tsx`: `GeneralView()` calls it.
- `apps/web/modules/users/components/UserForm.tsx`

**Callers of those callers (level 2)**
- Callers of `availabilityAsString()`:
  - `apps/web/test/lib/availabilityAsString.test.ts`
  - `packages/features/schedules/components/ScheduleListItem.tsx`
  - `packages/platform/atoms/availability/AvailabilitySettings.tsx`
- Callers of `AvailableTimesHeader`:
  - `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/AvailableTimeSlots.tsx`
  - `apps/web/modules/embed/components/Embed.tsx`
- Callers of `GeneralView`:
  - `apps/web/app/(use-page-wrapper)/settings/(settings-layout)/my-account/general/page.tsx`
- Callers of `UserForm`:
  - `apps/web/modules/users/views/users-add-view.tsx`
  - `apps/web/modules/users/views/users-edit-view.tsx`

A signature change only reaches the level-2 files if it also changes the return type or the signatures of the level-1 functions. Otherwise, only the 5 direct callers need edits.

I left out some files the graph lists. Many other files import from `packages/lib/availability.ts`, but not `availabilityAsString`. `TravelScheduleModal.tsx` only imports the `FormValues` type from `general-view`.
